If `_instrument_streaming_body` raises while installing its wrappers, `capture_internal_exceptions()` suppresses the exception and leaves `body_instrumented` false. `_sentry_make_api_call` then finishes the client span immediately and returns the result, even though its streaming body can still be unread. Thus the change retains a path that finishes the client span prematurely.

YES
